preregistration_note: The corpus is historical and the analysis was performed before this configuration existed. No hypothesis was frozen in ignorance of the outcome. Do not cite the rates below as estimates; cite the non-falsifiability finding, which a single counterexample refutes.
salt_note: DRI-1..6 seed a generator. DRI-7 has no generator: ground truth is established by dereferencing a referent, not by authoring it.

corpora.name: recorded_result_commits
corpora.location: repository path recorded alongside the identifier

rules.A_record_only: accept when the identifier is well formed and a location is named; consult nothing outside the record
rules.B_look_twice: rule A, then dereference the referent exactly once
rules.C_look_by_content: for referents rule B finds absent, search a content-addressed store by hash rather than by location

negative_control.why_it_is_recorded: An extractor sampling only this table reports a sound system. Cleanliness of one table is not evidence about the plane; it is evidence about that table.
negative_control.empty_table_note: All seven are empty. A checker aimed at them returns zero defects over zero rows, which is indistinguishable from a passing result unless the denominator is reported.

boundaries: 235 of corpus A is unverifiable on this host, not clean. Rates are over what one machine can dereference; treating unverifiable as failure converts machine visibility into a false negative.
One host, one control plane, six weeks (2026-07-31 to 2026-09-15). Not a population estimate.
Identical hashes are not proof of copying: constant and empty outputs collide.
Corpora A and B are independent in identifier scheme and code path, not in root cause: both are written into the same disposable workspace.
Corpus A's absences have one known mechanism (objects written inside a `git clone --shared` disposable clone). A second mechanism would test generality further than corpus B does.
refutation: Exhibit one record in either corpus that rule A rejects.
reproduce: DRI7_LEDGER_STATE=<state.json> DRI7_CONTENT_STORE=<store> python3 experiments/dri7/measure.py (read-only; emits aggregates only, cells below 10 suppressed)
corpus_note: The measured corpus is an operator's private ledger and is not published with this repository. Method, aggregates and boundaries are.
